'''Shedu Maad''' was a world in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]], located within its [[Transitory Mists]] region.<ref name="Invincible" />

==History==
Shedu Maad was once exploited as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world. During this period, [[Uroro Station]] served as a transfer station for [[Hapan]] ships traveling along [[the Throat]] to Shedu Maad. However, mining resources eventually vanished<ref name="TCSWE2">{{CSWECite|III|283|Uroro Station}}</ref> and the entire world was abandoned.<ref name="Invincible" />

An abandoned mining complex on Shedu Maad was used as a hidden base for the [[Jedi Coalition]] after they evacuated their temporary [[Jedi Outpost|base]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> It was here that the Coalition [[Battle of Uroro Station|defeated]] [[Darth Caedus]] and ended the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Invincible" /> A [[Jedi Academy (Shedu Maad)|Jedi academy]] was established on the planet after the war.<ref name="MF" />

In [[43 ABY]], during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] [[Skirmish at the Krabbis Inn|carried]] four Jedi who had contracted [[Force psychosis]] — [[Natua Wan]], [[Seff Hellin]], [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], and [[Bazel Warv]] — to the academy in order to prevent them from being frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]].<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>

When the [[New Jedi Order]] withdrew from The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, after [[Liberation of Coruscant|defeating]] [[Abeloth]] and the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], they moved to a secret base in Shedu Maad,<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> where they would begin their search for [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Lost Tribe.<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
